overview.description: The JPMorgan Flexible Income ETF (JFLI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is an actively managed fund that provides current income through exposure to global equities, bonds including MBS/ABS, preferred stock, MLPs, and REITs. JFLI was launched on Feb 12, 2025 and is issued by JPMorgan Chase.
